gre_general.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate does not require the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required.

toefl_min.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate sets a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 100 for admission.
toefl_min.quote: Mechanical Engineering requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, IELTS score of 7.5, or Duolingo score of 120 for admittance

ielts_min.value: The mechanical engineering doctorate sets a minimum IELTS score of 7.5 for admission.
ielts_min.quote: Mechanical Engineering requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, IELTS score of 7.5, or Duolingo score of 120 for admittance

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 15, 2026; the official table prints no year.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: Admission is not tied to a named supervisor: students are assigned a faculty advisor after they enrol.
supervisor.quote: Students are assigned a faculty advisor upon matriculation

funding.value: The School of Engineering says full-time PhD students often receive a tuition scholarship; the page does not say that most are funded.

also.quote: Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

english_waiver.value: The department requires a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo minimum for admittance, so the graduate-school English exemption does not remove the test requirement.
english_waiver.quote: Mechanical Engineering requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, IELTS score of 7.5, or Duolingo score of 120 for admittance

notes: The department minimums are the minimum for one of TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.5 or Duolingo 120. Students are assigned an advisor after admission. Entry route is not stated on the page.
